name: RESTORE Colorado Program
summary: Annual NFWF grants, with Great Outdoors Colorado and other partners, for at-scale habitat restoration and stewardship in Colorado: wetlands, riparian areas, grasslands, sagebrush rangelands and migration corridors.

status.quote: Due Dates Due Date Name 11/12/2026 RESTORE Colorado Program 2027 Request for Proposals

deadline.quote: 11/12/2026 RESTORE Colorado Program 2027 Request for Proposals

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include non-profit 501(c)3 organizations, political subdivisions of the state, local and municipal governments, Native Nations and Indigenous-led organizations, and educational institutions.

geography.quote: All projects must occur entirely within the State of Colorado.

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

window.quote: The National Fish and Wildlife Foundation (NFWF) is soliciting proposals for the annual Restoration and Stewardship of Outdoor Resources and Environment (RESTORE) Colorado Program.

amount.quote: with a minimum grant amount of $100,000.

co_finance_required.quote: leverage and match is encouraged but not required.
